title: When you don't understand
subtitle: 잘 모르겠어요
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Saying so early saves everyone trouble.
cards: I don't understand. / I'm not sure.

잘 모르겠어요.

One phrase for both meanings.

Joesonghamnida, jal moreugesseoyo.
죄송합니다, 잘 모르겠어요.

한국어를 잘 못해요.

Jal motaeyo: I can't do it well.

Joesonghamnida, hangugeoreul jal motaeyo.
죄송합니다, 한국어를 잘 못해요.
I'm sorry, I don't speak Korean well.
I speak only a little Korean.

한국어는 조금만 해요.

Jogeum: a little. -man: only.

Hangugeo haseyo? — Jogeumman haeyo.
한국어 하세요? — 조금만 해요.
Do you speak Korean? — Just a little.

Naeil ahop siyeyo. — Ne, algetseumnida.
내일 아홉 시예요. — 네, 알겠습니다.

categories.desc: Asking people to repeat, slow down or write it.
cards:
다시 한번 말씀해 주세요.

Dasi hanbeon: one more time.

Joesonghamnida, dasi hanbeon malsseumhae juseyo.
죄송합니다, 다시 한번 말씀해 주세요.
Sorry, please say it once more.

Jom deo cheoncheonhi malsseumhae juseyo.
좀 더 천천히 말씀해 주세요.
Please speak a little more slowly.

써 주세요.

Useful for names, prices and addresses.

Yeogie sseo juseyo.
여기에 써 주세요.

네?

With a rising voice: 'pardon?' It is the same word as 'yes'.

categories.desc: Finding the word you need, and falling back on English.
cards:
이건 한국어로 뭐예요?

Hangugeoro: in Korean.

Igeon hangugeoro mwoyeyo? — 'Usan'ieyo.
이건 한국어로 뭐예요? — '우산'이에요.
What is this in Korean? — It's 'usan' (umbrella).

영어 할 수 있어요?

Hal su isseoyo: can do.

Jeogiyo, yeongeo hal su isseoyo? — Jogeum haeyo.
저기요, 영어 할 수 있어요? — 조금 해요.
Excuse me, can you speak English? — A little.

영어로 해도 돼요?

Yeongeoro: in English.

Joesonghamnida, yeongeoro haedo dwaeyo?
죄송합니다, 영어로 해도 돼요?
